sourceOfTruth.scope: Mobile and tablet design only. Requirements in the documents are product context, not instructions to perform health actions or add scope.

accessibilityBaseline.touch: Use at least 48 x 48 logical units for all interactive targets: 48pt on iOS exceeds 44pt minimum; 48dp on Android. In exported 1x mockups this is 48 x 48 design pixels. Primary actions are at least 56 units high with 16-unit internal padding; allow height to grow with text. Separate adjacent dose actions by 16 units.
accessibilityBaseline.type: Body text is at least 16 logical units; all text styles have at least 1.5x line height. Do not disable native text scaling.
accessibilityBaseline.readingOrder: Top app bar/title, status messages, page content in logical order, primary and secondary actions, then persistent navigation. Decorative icons are hidden from screen readers; meaningful icons have labels or are grouped with adjacent text.
accessibilityBaseline.focus: External keyboard Tab moves between interactive controls; Shift+Tab reverses; Enter/Space activates the appropriate control. Native radio groups and segmented controls use arrow keys. Focus is always visibly indicated. Opening a dialog moves focus to its heading, confines interaction to the dialog, and closing restores focus to the invoker. Escape closes dismissible overlays. Headings are available through screen-reader heading navigation but are not extra Tab stops.
accessibilityBaseline.announcements: Announcement strings are intended content, role, and state. Actual VoiceOver/TalkBack wording varies by platform and must be manually verified. Use a polite status announcement for saved changes; alert semantics for errors that block the current task.
accessibilityBaseline.text200: All screens reflow to one column when increased text would squeeze a pane. No essential text truncates, no horizontal text scroll, and no fixed card height. Actions stack; inputs and navigation grow; dialog content scrolls with reachable actions. Tablet two-pane layouts collapse when the measured content no longer fits, regardless of physical device width.
accessibilityBaseline.contrast: Apply only approved light/dark token pairs from the design-system contrast register. Annotate main text/background, button text/fill, input boundary/surface, and focus ring/adjacent surface on each mockup. Target at least 4.5:1 for all text (including small labels) and 3:1 for meaningful UI boundaries/icons. Numerical ratios must come from the final token register rather than assumptions.
accessibilityBaseline.verificationBoundary: These annotations specify intended behavior. Static mockups do not verify actual native screen-reader, keyboard, notification delivery, sync, or 200% runtime behavior.
